title: Design: Batch invoice prints a band only on invoices billed to someone else
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A and customer B with an asset that has a unit, year, make and model (for example Unit 854, 2024 INTERNATIONAL CV515), so the document has a customer, a different payer and a unit to print.
  • Have invoice 1: customer B billed to customer A. Have invoice 2: customer B billing itself. Both invoiced after the Bill To release, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Set the document design to legacy (Settings, invoice and estimate design).
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p4-22-after-batch-page-1.png, bt-p4-21-before-batch-page-1.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Invoices list.
  2. Tick invoice 1.
  3. Tick invoice 2.
  4. Print the selected invoices as one batch.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens.

Step 2:

  • Invoice 1's row is ticked.

Step 3:

  • Both rows are ticked.

Step 4:

  • Invoice 1's page has the SERVICE FOR band under the Bill To row.
  • Invoice 2's page has no band.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12310 (Story 8, "Service For" band on invoices and estimates)

  • S8-R6: “The band prints on the modern and legacy layouts, invoice and estimate, part sale invoice and batch invoice.”
  • S8-N1: “When the customer pays for itself, no band prints and the document is unchanged.”
